question: For each type of place, calculate the average duration (in seconds) of visits made by people with 'Healthy' status and the average duration of visits made by people with 'Under the weather' status. Return the place type, average healthy visit duration, and average Under the weather visit duration.
pred_cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(v:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(pl:Place)
WHERE p.healthstatus = "Healthy"
WITH pl.type AS place_type, collect(duration.between(v.starttime, v.endtime).seconds) AS healthy_durations
WITH place_type, reduce(s = 0.0, x IN healthy_durations | s + x) / size(healthy_durations) AS avg_healthy
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:Person)-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(v2:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(pl2:Place)
WHERE p2.healthstatus = "Under the weather" AND pl2.type = place_type
WITH place_type, avg_healthy, collect(duration.between(v2.starttime, v2.endtime).seconds) AS under_weather_durations
RETURN place_type,
       avg_healthy,
       CASE WHEN size(under_weather_durations) > 0
            THEN reduce(s = 0.0, x IN under_weather_durations | s + x) / size(under_weather_durations)
            ELSE null END AS avg_under_weather
gold_cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[v:VISITS]->(pl:Place)
WHERE v.duration.seconds IS NOT NULL
WITH pl.type AS placeType, p.healthstatus AS healthStatus, v.duration.seconds AS duration
WITH placeType, 
     AVG(CASE WHEN healthStatus = 'Healthy' THEN duration ELSE null END) AS avgHealthyDuration,
     AVG(CASE WHEN healthStatus = 'Sick' THEN duration ELSE null END) AS avgSickDuration
RETURN placeType, avgHealthyDuration, avgSickDuration
